race.comment: ROBERT THE PUSS (5) missed the frame in town last start but does tend to run well here and drops back to his level. Bold showing anticipated. HIDDEN BOUNTY (2) booted up from the inside draw to sit on the speed last start then went on to register a determined win by half a length at Naracoorte over 1430m. Sure to go well again. TALLAPOOSA (10) is knocking on the door after just missing last time over 1300m at Warrnambool. Comes down a level this time and is right in the mix. LIMOSA (11) caught the eye late when working home nicely into midfield. Less effective last time but can get things back on track off a freshen. Not taking lightly.
